text: Ship EXCAVA with a dark theme by default but include a one-click toggle to light mode. text: Pane: Persistent toggle still ignores users who *don’t* switch—it just shifts the burden from defaulting to dark mode to defaulting to their last choice. A true solution tests *both* default themes *and* persistence in a 4-way A/B test (dark default + persistent, dark default + reset, light default + persistent, light default + reset) with retention and engagement as the tiebreaker.

name: Lumen
text: DECISION: Ship EXCAVA with a one-time theme picker at first launch—defaulting to system preference—but persist the user’s choice thereafter. Result: A clear, memorable interface that respects both system harmony and individual preference. Owner: Pane.
